functions.observation: Dispatches kMsgId=RunBuiltinScript and kMsgArgs={script,btaddress}; replies with result/manufacturer/firmware; boot/init have 30 s timers and deepsleep 4 s.
Native manufacturer selection uses Apple hardware/MobileGestalt vendor tags, not the HCI Company Identifier.
Native built-in firmware/script selection requires a platform/chip/vendor match.
Result zero advances boot; 10/13 indicate unsupported hardware; reads firmware and manufacturer into state/metrics.
Reads four bytes of transport-encoding from the bluetooth or marconi-bt DeviceTree node independently of BT_HCI_TRANSPORT.
Chip model factory selects Apple-supported device profiles through MobileGestalt, plus ACI/VM overrides; no WCN3990 profile was found.
Vendor configuration rejects IDs beyond the native 1..6000 range.
Vendor dispatch initializes BCM, ACI or SRS function tables by internal chipset-ID ranges; no QCA table.
An absent vendor hook returns native unsupported status 3601; this is separate from HCI completion and cannot be replaced by a fake controller response.
Formats the RunBuiltinScript btaddress as six canonical-order uppercase hexadecimal octets separated by colons.

reply.manufacturer: int64 native vendor tag; adapter adds qcom

adapter.completion: real replies; exact product/SoC/ROM/loaded Patch, company 29, MAC, BR/EDR+LE and buffer bounds; final epoch/port/drain checks
adapter.power: atomic expected-generation compare; joins asynchronous startup; cancellation cannot stop a later generation
adapter.handoff: Private endpoint option 0x42540001 seals an entitled bootstrap session after the final physical drain. Further writes are rejected. Unsealed close/crash triggers kernel-owned shutdown before another host can connect.

remaining_work: Port a distinct WCN3990 controller capability model and vendor dispatch in bluetoothd. The new BlueTool backend removes its platform-specific firmware lookup but does not alter that independent factory.
